Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On Sep 14, 2:35 pm, "Kevin M." wrote:
> Could a few players describe how the RapidThought tournament
> at Dragon*Con went?  

It was a 6 player event on Friday.
Scott, Oscar, and a third player were in the finals.

Scott was playing Tremere with lots of bounce, Oscar was playing
fortitude/celerity/presence bleed, the third player was weenie
dementation, if I remember correctly.

> I'm interested in the decks, the winning
> deck, if anything seemed overly or too strong, if anyone played
> The Una Deck, and whatever other details you'd like to give.

To the best of my recollection, the dementation player never bled the
wrong way around the table.
Oscar's deck went forward, hard and fast, and he had AI played on him
twice in one game.

Oscar pulled out the win in the finals.
